description: This method returns the details and status for an array of tasks based on a specified feed_type or scheduledId.

parameters.name: date_range
parameters.description: Specifies the range of task creation dates used to filter the results.

parameters.name: feed_type
parameters.description: The feed type associated with the tasks to be returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of tasks that can be returned per page.

parameters.name: look_back_days
parameters.description: The number of previous days in which to search for tasks.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of tasks to skip in the result set.

parameters.name: schedule_id
parameters.description: The schedule ID associated with the task.
